name: When must a criminal defense attorney withdraw from your case?

mainEntity.name: When must a criminal defense attorney withdraw from your case?

acceptedAnswer.text: An attorney must withdraw if unable to provide competent representation, faces a conflict of interest, or cannot ethically or legally advocate on your behalf as required by professional standards.nlada​
